title: papaver paeoniiflorum
intro: Papaver paeoniiflorum, commonly known as Poppy of the Paeony, is a plant species in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as relief from inflammation, pain, and anxiety, as well as its potential to improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Papaver paeoniiflorum include sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
